title: A careful first collaboration with DEE-P Connections (DEEP)

sentences.text: From the KCNT1 Epilepsy Foundation, we invite DEEP to explore a practical collaboration for families.
KCNT1 and KCNQ2 both help potassium channels work.
The atlas infers overlapping seizures and severe developmental delays, but this similarity has confidence 0.48, below 0.5.
It also infers DEEP's connection to KCNQ2 families from a KCNQ2 Cure Alliance partnership logo, not a formal membership record.

sections.heading: What already exists that we could share

sentences.text: Our Foundation manages the KCNT1 International Registry on NORD IAMRARE for people with KCNT1-related disorders.
Citizen Health includes KCNT1, and epilepsy-dyskinesia study and registry records list both KCNT1 and KCNQ2.
We could start by sharing registry experience rather than promising cross-disease enrollment.

sections.heading: What must be checked before we join forces

sentences.text: Before offering the registry to KCNQ2 families, let us confirm eligibility and whether its questions fit their needs.

Please help check whether KCNQ2 families experience focal autonomic seizures with palpitations, fast or slow heartbeat or heart pauses; inability to walk by childhood or adolescence; and personality disorder, rather than treating missing records as absence.
We should identify additional KCNT1 organizations, registries, trials and research groups, and check which individual variants increase activity, impair protein activity or cause loss of function.
The proposed 'one working copy is not enough' links for both genes are atlas inferences, unverified and below 0.5 confidence.
Hold one joint registry-review call this month to decide whether and how an offer to KCNQ2 families could be appropriate.
What additional patient organizations, registries, trials and research groups exist for KCNT1-related disorders beyond those verified here?
Which individual variants are activating, catalytically impaired or loss of function?
Dear DEE-P Connections (DEEP),
We would welcome a small, family-focused collaboration.
Our Foundation manages the KCNT1 International Registry on NORD IAMRARE.
Could we review its suitability for KCNQ2 families together this month?
Let us check eligibility and differences before making any offer.
Thank you for considering this conversation.
[Your name], on behalf of KCNT1 Epilepsy Foundation
